Supabase JavaScript SDK 2.119.0

`supabase.js` is the unmodified UMD distribution from the official
`@supabase/supabase-js` npm package. Its MIT license is included alongside it.
The SDK is served locally so account pages do not depend on a runtime CDN.

To reproduce using npm, install `@supabase/supabase-js@2.119.0` in a temporary
directory and copy `dist/umd/supabase.js` and `LICENSE` from that package.
